description: Returns available data vintages: Form 477 filing periods (hardcoded Jun 2015 – Jun 2021, always available) and BDC as-of dates from the authenticated API (Jun 2022 onward, requires credentials). Call this before fcc_list_downloads to determine valid as_of_date values. Note: there is a data gap between June 2021 (last Form 477) and June 2022 (first BDC filing period).

include_bdc.description: When true, also fetches BDC as-of dates from the authenticated API (requires FCC_BDC_USERNAME and FCC_BDC_HASH_VALUE). When false (default), returns only hardcoded Form 477 periods.

name: fcc_list_filing_periods

bdcCount.description: Number of BDC periods returned (0 when credentials not configured or include_bdc=false).

dataNote.description: Note on data availability and the Form 477 vs. BDC gap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

form477Count.description: Number of Form 477 periods returned (always available).

hasBdcCredentials.description: Whether BDC API credentials are configured in this deployment.

periods.description: Available filing periods sorted newest first.

asOfDate.description: Filing period as-of date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2021-06-30").

publicationDate.description: Date the dataset was published, if available.

source.description: "form477" = legacy ISP-reported data (2015–2021). "bdc" = Broadband Data Collection (2022+).

title: List Filing Periods
